hand_edits.why: C24 — while thinking he stared down the camera. The gaze target is camera-anchored (look.ts), so the old offset was 12.0 deg lateral and 7.5 deg up at the staging camera, and BOTH eyes sat pinned at the lateral roam limit (PUPIL_ROAM.x = 0.115) because the aim saturates there by 2.3x from the staging geometry alone. The new offset is 36.8 deg lateral and 32.0 deg up, which takes both pupils OFF the clamp (max 84 percent of the limit at either facing) and up to the top of their vertical travel. That is also D14: an iris pinned at the roam limit is an iris against the rim of its sclera.
hand_edits.WARNING: THIS FILE IS GENERATED, AND THESE VALUES ARE NOT. gen-playbook.py has been broken since 2026-08-16, so this edit was made by hand in the committed JSON. Regenerating the playbook WILL SILENTLY REVERT IT unless the same numbers are ported into the generator and its normative Python source first. Anything that reads this file should treat hand_edits as the list of places where the file and the generator disagree.

units.axis: Blender Z-up. Convert to three.js Y-up: pos x->x, y->-z, z->y; rot rx->rx, ry->-rz, rz->ry. Scale is NOT converted.

transition.snap_reason: stepped-interpolation clips turn to mush when crossfaded
transition.snap_note: `thinking` is listed as a snap state upstream but was rebuilt on 2026-08-17 as a spring rock with zero step beats; the stated reason no longer applies to it.
transition.non_resting_note: `boot` starts squashed and shut by design. The `sym_spin`/`sym_frame` residue on alert_dizzy and alert_scribble is harmless -- the glyph is parked off-screen once `alert` returns to 0 -- but it is real and must not be asserted away.

idle_float.note: irrational frequency ratios so the hover never visibly repeats. t is SECONDS. Rate multiplies a separately integrated clock -- never scale t, or the phase jumps on every state entry.

blink.compose_note: lower_lid_ratio and the max rule are stated in wiki/procedural/blink.md but are ABSENT from decke_proc.py -- design intent, not measured.

glance_away.note: blink-masked; suppressed entirely in gaze_lock states. Flits still run there.

flight.note: Timing is a simulated runtime controller, NOT a baked curve. The PROFILE_* Catmull-Rom tables the wiki describes no longer exist.
flight.lean_model: theta = LEAD_ACC*accel + LEAD_SPD*speed, clamped to LEAD_MAX. acceleration-driven, per theta=arctan(a/g). braking leans BACK.

controller.metric: cumulative NDC screen distance + SCREEN_MIX * world distance. cruise/antic/overshoot/eps are ALL in this camera-dependent dimensionless metric -- not world units, not pixels. Re-derive against the live camera.
controller.fixed_step: the integrator has no dt: a_acc/a_dec are per-frame^2 and the eps values are per-frame. Bake at a fixed 30Hz step, then interpolate for playback. Do NOT drive from rAF.

loop.disabled_note: decke_states passes loop=False on both far legs. The flourish was cut: the roll threw his face around a 1.6u circle, the tangent swept through vertical where the yaw model is degenerate, and the circle was ~1 body height so he overlapped his own path.
loop.roll_channel: DeckE_Roll, AXIS_ANGLE. NEVER the euler channels: a 360 turn crosses euler's gimbal singularity.

symbol_atlas.encoding: signed distance field, 0.5 = edge. RED is the primary glyph, GREEN a second pass drawn over it. For every symbol except the spinner R == G so the second layer is a no-op.
symbol_atlas.clip_note: in-cell clipping is REQUIRED -- without a test that the sampled UV lies inside [0,1]^2 of the chosen cell, points outside the glyph sample the neighbouring cell and bleed the wrong symbol.

card_stash.note: per-card XYZ waypoints are ABSENT from every source; only this timing schedule survives.
